evals.prompt: I have a bunch of hex tile PNGs in Design/hex-crops-v2/ that are 120x104 pixels with a black border around each hex shape. I need to clip them to just the hexagon on a transparent background — remove the white corners and the black border. They're flat-top hexagons. Can you process all of them and save the results?
evals.expected_output: Properly clipped hex PNGs with transparent backgrounds, no border artifacts, anti-aliased edges. All 51 tiles should pass validation.

evals.prompt: I have an image at Design/hex-crops-v2/ocean.png that's a flat-top hexagonal tile (120x104px). I need to cut it into a clean hexagon shape with transparency outside the hex. The image has a ~4px black border I want to exclude. Save it as ocean_clipped.png and show me it's correct.
evals.expected_output: A single cleanly clipped hex PNG with transparent corners, no black border remnants, center pixel opaque, transparency ratio around 39-45%.

evals.prompt: I need to composite two images together. Take the ocean hex tile and overlay it on top of a green (#2d5a1e) background canvas that's 200x200 pixels, centered. The hex tile should keep its transparency so you can see the green background through the corners.
evals.expected_output: A 200x200 PNG showing the hex ocean tile centered on a green background, with green visible in the hex corners. The hex edges should be clean.
